reconcile.note: Henry insists the Lord of hosts who trains for battle and the God of peace hailed in the New Testament are the very same God, not two natures at odds.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Marcion of Sinope catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.

sides.snippet: Yahweh is a man of war.
sides.verseText: Yahweh is a man of war. Yahweh is his name.

sides.snippet: Now the God of peace be with you all.
sides.verseText: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
